segments.text:
V. 14.
Ye ought alſo to waſh one another's feet—And why did they not? Why do we not read of any one Apoſtle ever waſhing the Feet of any other? Becauſe they underſtood their LORD better. They knew He never deſigned that this ſhould be literally taken. He deſigned to teach them the great Leſſon of humble Love, as well as to confer inward Purity upon them. And hereby He teaches us,
1. In every poſſible Way to aſſiſt each other in attaining that Purity;
2. To waſh each other's Feet, by performing all Sorts of good Offices to each other, even thoſe of the loweſt Kind, when Opportunity ſerves, and the Neceſſity of any calls for them.
